newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 18.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Nationwide survey shows China's industry development shows significant acceleration
- President Jiang Zemin attends funeral of former defence minister Qin Jiwei, Deng Xiaoping sends condolences
- Vice Premier Zhu Rongji presides at session to study economic theories of Deng Xiaoping
- Central bank vice governor Chen Yuan outlines future links between Hong Kong and mainland after July 1 handover
- Ministry of Internal Trade, State Grain Reserve Bureau call for strengthening of state grain purchasing work
- Special announcement says Vice Premier Zhu Rongji arranges seminar to study economic theories of Deng Xiaoping
- Government survey says 20 listed companies have entered ranks of China's largest, including Changhong Electronic, Tsingtao Beer, Haier Group
- China expected to issue 200 billion yuan of tradeable bonds in 1997, accouting for 80 percent of total state debt issue for the year
- China announces 123 billion yuan bond issue
- State Council circular targets smoother transport to ease congestion
- Overseas investment fuels growth in Beijing
